# NeuroChem — Full Pharmacology & Peer-Reviewed Reference

Interactive Three.js human brain pharmacology visualizer mapping 10 neuroactive compounds across 8 anatomical brain structures, a 5-stage pharmacokinetic timeline (0h, 1h, Peak Tmax, t1/2 Clearance, Years Chronic), live 3D synaptic neuro-reactions, and multi-compound stack synergies and clinical cautions.

## 8 Anatomical Brain Structures

- `pfc`: Prefrontal Cortex (volumetric GLSL cortical lobe highlight on real folded gyri)
- `raphe`: Midbrain · Dorsal Raphe Nuclei (serotonergic origin)
- `locus`: Pons · Locus Coeruleus (noradrenergic origin)
- `hippocampus`: Bilateral Hippocampus (memory consolidation, adult neurogenesis)
- `amygdala`: Bilateral Amygdala (emotional salience and threat modulation)
- `striatum`: Bilateral Striatum & Nucleus Accumbens (dopaminergic reward and motor gating)
- `thalamus`: Thalamus (sensory relay and thalamocortical alpha rhythm)
- `cerebellum`: Cerebellum (motor-cognitive timing and bioenergetic demand)

## 10 Compounds, Pharmacokinetics & Primary Literature

1. **SSRIs (`ssri`)** | Escitalopram | t1/2: 27-32h | Tmax: 3-4h | Targets: `raphe`, `hippocampus`, `pfc`, `amygdala` | Ref: Meyer et al., Am J Psychiatry (2004) https://doi.org/10.1176/appi.ajp.161.5.826
2. **SNRIs (`snri`)** | Venlafaxine | t1/2: 5-11h (parent/ODV) | Tmax: 2-4h | Targets: `locus`, `pfc`, `thalamus`, `striatum` | Ref: Klamerus et al., J Clin Pharmacol (1992) https://doi.org/10.1002/j.1552-4604.1992.tb03875.x
3. **Caffeine (`caffeine`)** | 1,3,7-Trimethylxanthine | t1/2: 4-6h | Tmax: 30-60m | Targets: `striatum`, `pfc`, `thalamus` | Ref: Volkow et al., Transl Psychiatry (2015) https://doi.org/10.1038/tp.2015.46
4. **L-Theanine (`theanine`)** | Gamma-glutamylethylamide | t1/2: 1.5-2h | Tmax: 45-60m | Targets: `thalamus`, `hippocampus`, `pfc` | Ref: Owen et al., Nutr Neurosci (2008) https://doi.org/10.1179/147683008X301513
5. **Creatine (`creatine`)** | Creatine Monohydrate | t1/2: 30-45d (brain pool) | Tmax: 2-4w | Targets: `pfc`, `striatum`, `cerebellum` | Ref: Dechent et al., Am J Physiol (1999) https://doi.org/10.1152/ajpregu.1999.277.3.R698 ; Lyoo et al., Am J Psychiatry (2012) https://doi.org/10.1176/appi.ajp.2012.12010009
6. **Stimulants (`stimulant`)** | Methylphenidate | t1/2: 2.5-3.5h | Tmax: 1.5-2h | Targets: `striatum`, `pfc`, `thalamus` | Ref: Volkow et al., Am J Psychiatry (1998) https://doi.org/10.1176/ajp.155.10.1325
7. **Psilocybin (`psilocybin`)** | Active: Psilocin | t1/2: 2.5-3h | Tmax: 75-90m | Targets: `pfc`, `thalamus`, `hippocampus`, `amygdala` | Ref: Carhart-Harris et al., PNAS (2012) https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.1119598109 ; Shao et al., Neuron (2021) https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuron.2021.06.008
8. **Mg Threonate (`magnesium`)** | Magnesium L-Threonate | t1/2: 4-5h | Tmax: 2h | Targets: `hippocampus`, `pfc` | Ref: Slutsky et al., Neuron (2010) https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuron.2009.12.026
9. **Ketamine (`ketamine`)** | Ketamine / Esketamine | t1/2: 2-3h | Tmax: 30-40m | Targets: `pfc`, `hippocampus`, `amygdala` | Ref: Li et al., Science (2010) https://doi.org/10.1126/science.1190287 ; Zanos et al., Nature (2016) https://doi.org/10.1038/nature17998
10. **Lithium (`lithium`)** | Lithium | t1/2: 18-24h | Tmax: 1-2h | Targets: `pfc`, `amygdala`, `hippocampus` | Ref: Klein & Melton, PNAS (1996) https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.93.16.8455 ; Moore et al., Lancet (2000) https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(00)02793-8
